findings.section: Proposed SQLite schema, transactions and crash consistency
findings.note: The DB path is called feature-local/per-feature, but `.specify/recovery/recovery.sqlite3` resolves at the project root and is shared across features; `task_id` is the primary key. Clarify an actually feature-scoped DB path or explicitly define central-store isolation, collision-free keys, and backup/restore boundaries.

The selected optional-pack test asserts six plugins disabled but checks only four absent profile names (`nfr-hardening`, `brownfield`, `release-ready`, `skeleton-first`). The blanket statement that optional profile names are absent exceeds those assertions; name the four or add separately authorized assertions. The cited test selectors themselves exist.
